club.title: Player Council announced
club.body: HCC is launching a holder-led Player Council: 4 elected seats + 3 appointed seats. Holders will have a structured way to give feedback, make creative recommendations, and participate in scoped decisions around Gen 2, drop themes, Creature Shop, and roadmap direction. Not a DAO — Pocket Worlds keeps final say on business, economy, and safety.

club.title: ItsVini takes over as project lead
club.body: Vinicius Cabral (ItsVini) has taken full responsibility and accountability for HCC — decisions, delivery, and community management. Tom, the previous lead, built the foundation this project stands on.

club.title: Council site open sourced
club.body: The HCC Player Council site is now public on GitHub. Community members can open Issues to flag typos, suggest changes, or request content. Developers can fork the repo and submit Pull Requests. Nothing goes live without review first.

site.title: Player Council page launches
site.body: Initial release covering Club overview, Council structure, holder stats, and roadmap.

site.title: Multilingual support — 7 languages
site.body: Full page translations live in English, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, French, German, and Turkish.

site.title: Changelog added
site.body: Separate tracking for Club matters and Site content updates.
